method: NAIP 2022-07-19 detail ortho (0.625 m/px, local extent +-640 m). Crown evidence = ExG>0.05 & brightness<0.55 & not-water, dilated 2.5 m (same gates as canopy_census.detect). Any pine placement (placements.json trees + placement_overrides add) whose trunk lands without crown evidence inside the detail extent is removed via placement_overrides.json remove[]
